description: Who controls users' assets and keys: custodial vs non-custodial claims, wallet control, pooled addresses, signing keys, who can initiate transfers.
watch_for: Claims like 'non-custodial', 'self-custodial', 'exclusive control', 'cannot move your assets without authorization' versus mechanics such as pooled or operational wallets, keys held by the company or its providers, company-initiated transfers, 'temporarily hold' language, freezing or seizing assets.

description: Withdrawal, redemption and exit rights: when and how users can take assets out, delays, suspension, fees, termination effects.
watch_for: Promises of withdrawal 'at any time' / 'instantly' / 'unconditionally' versus delay, suspension, queueing, liquidity requirements, discretionary restriction or freezing; termination or suspension clauses that affect access to deposited assets.

description: Liability, warranties, risk allocation and duties of care: what the operator accepts or disclaims responsibility for.
watch_for: Absolute 'not responsible' / 'no liability' statements versus assumed duties, guarantees or safekeeping obligations; liability caps versus 'unlimited' or 'full' liability; carve-outs that swallow the rule; disclaimers for losses in assets the operator claims not to control but actually holds.
